mapNotes: VD04 uses Tongsheng 0x59 UART. ParseDisplayUartFrame writes PAS 0–6 to 0x20002706 and max speed to 0x20002705 when the speed byte is greater than 10. Handlebar on-road/off-road hold-toggle stays on the display; the motor has one ceiling and applies whichever km/h the display sends.

UpdateDisplayWheelPeriodStatusBit (0x10008810) compares the P0.4 wheel-pulse period at 0x20002590 to kmh<<5 (stock 25 → 800) and writes display TX bit 0x40000. That cell is a period (stopped 4100), not km/h. Live motor taper is ApplyWheelSpeedFade. Unplugging the sensor leaves the period high (stopped), not low. Other movs #0x19 sites are an 800-tick timeout, a current-staging +800, fade-hi*25/22, and a torque-path 25<<5 at 0x1000834A.

ApplyAssistLevelTargets maps PAS 1–5 to percent immediates (30/50/70/85/100) at g_bAssistPercent (0x200026F9). CalculateTorqueAssistCurrent multiplies filtered torque demand by that byte. A separate FOC cap at g_wScaledAssist uses soft-float 0.4/0.5/0.8/0.9/1.0. PAS1/PAS3 share mantissa low-word 0x9999999A (locked); the high words are pas1_foc_scale / pas3_foc_scale. PAS4 0.9 at 0x10002FDC is independently patchable. PAS2 FOC is ScaleDoubleByPowerTwo(-n) via pas2_foc_scale (stock n=1 → 0.5).

PAS 0 is zero. PAS 6 is walk: RunRideControlLoop stores 450 into wCurrentTarget (ride-state+0x12). ApplyAssistLevelTargets then zeros the percent cell and writes walk_assist_fraction_sixteenths of full current (stock 3/16) into the other target words.

Startup 1000 / 728 / 641 in InitializeRideDefaults seed fade RAM (0x200025AC / 0x2000258A / 0x20002588). RebuildWheelSpeedFadeThresholds rebuilds them from wheel×speed, so the flash immediates do not stick. They are not in this map.

Rider settings change everyday speed/PAS/walk behavior. Advanced tunables are FOC, stall, hall, wheel-pulse timing, and protection constants — wrong values can stall, cut assist, or rotate commutation.

The VD04 max speed byte is 60. Raising the Speed ceiling slider only changes the display-status period compare. Live assist taper follows the fade table from wheel×display speed. Unlimit-when-display-60 remaps a stored 60 to 99 for fade math and forces display TX bit 0x40000 always on (bcc→b at 0x10008824) so the VD04 handshake is not stuck in legal 25/PAS 1. Disable-fade rewrites two short bcs in ApplyWheelSpeedFade to b (0x100088F6 and 0x10008922, same sites as donor patched HEX) so taper is skipped on both display 25 and 60. Analog throttle overlay is separate: the ride loop stages (ADC−600)×2+800 when PAS≠0 and ADC is in window, then PAS-full bumps FOC to PAS 5. Skip-throttle-lockout nops the bmi that skips that map when dwAssistBits 0x40000 is set (assist word 0x20002690, not the display TX 0x40000); Off-road unlimit leaves that and the stock 1241 window off so it matches the donor HEX that already had working throttle. Unlimit-power skips the battery over/under-voltage flags and low-voltage foldback; its raise-slew site can still wind the limit down when avg < UV. Ride current clamp 0 keeps the derived g_wFullCurrentLimit; 450–32767 replaces ConvertFloatToSignedInt with a Thumb uint16. Display max-speed is accepted only when the UART byte is greater than 10.

speed_ceiling_kmh.label: Speed ceiling
speed_ceiling_kmh.summary: Display-status period threshold encoded as km/h then <<5 (stock 25 → 800 ticks). Sets TX bit 0x40000 when wheel period is below that. Because period shrinks as speed rises, a higher slider value asserts the bit at lower wheel speeds. Live motor taper is Speed fade / Unlimit-when-display-60, not this compare.
speed_ceiling_kmh.notes: UpdateDisplayWheelPeriodStatusBit: movs r3,#imm; lsls #5; blo sets display TX 0x40000 when P0.4 period at 0x20002590 is below the threshold. Period is written by UpdateWheelPulsePeriod (stopped 4100, boot seed 4500), not a km/h<<5 speed. Raising the immediate raises the period ceiling, so the bit turns on sooner (slower). Rebuild fade periods use ~573*wheel/speed, so stock 800 ticks is nearer ~20 km/h on wheel code 28 than a hard 25 km/h wall. Assist taper is ApplyWheelSpeedFade. Unlimit-when-display-60 forces the period compare blo to always take the SET path (bcc→b at 0x10008824); it does not change this km/h immediate.

default_max_speed_kmh.label: Default max speed
default_max_speed_kmh.summary: Boot-up max speed only. The display overwrites it as soon as it sends a speed greater than 10. Leave this unless the display is unplugged or not talking.
default_max_speed_kmh.notes: InitializeRideDefaults writes this byte to both 0x20002705 (live display speed) and 0x20002703 (last-cache). RebuildWheelSpeedFadeThresholds rebuilds the fade table only when those two differ, then copies live→cache. A live 0x59 frame overwrites 0x20002705 when speed > uart_min_display_speed_kmh (or wheel code also changes). Patching this without a display-speed change can leave cache matching live, so the fade table is not rebuilt until the display sends a different byte.

default_wheel_code.label: Default wheel-size code
default_wheel_code.summary: Boot-up wheel-size code (Tongsheng 6–34, stock 28). Not millimeters. The display usually overwrites this; it only matters if the display never sends a wheel byte.
default_wheel_code.notes: InitializeRideDefaults stores 0x1C (28) to both 0x20002704 (live wheel code) and 0x20002702 (last-cache). RebuildWheelSpeedFadeThresholds rebuilds fade only when live ≠ last, using the live wheel byte (valid 6–34). Patching this without a display wheel-byte change can skip that rebuild. Silent-display default, not circumference in mm.

default_pas_level.label: Default PAS level
default_pas_level.summary: PAS level used from power-on until the display sends the first valid frame. After that the handlebar buttons own it.
default_pas_level.notes: InitializeRideDefaults writes 5 to 0x20002706 before the first 0x59 frame. ParseDisplayUartFrame then overwrites it from assist-flag bits. Capped at 5 so a silent display cannot boot into walk (PAS 6).

pas1_percent.label: PAS 1 assist
pas1_percent.summary: How hard PAS 1 pulls from the torque sensor (stock 30%). Raise for more help on level 1. This is not the FOC current cap.
pas1_percent.notes: ApplyAssistLevelTargets writes 30 to g_bAssistPercent. CalculateTorqueAssistCurrent multiplies filtered torque demand by this byte. The FOC current cap for PAS 1 is a separate soft-float 0.4 and is not this immediate.

pas2_percent.label: PAS 2 assist
pas2_percent.summary: How hard PAS 2 pulls from the torque sensor (stock 50%). Raise for more help on level 2.
pas2_percent.notes: Torque-demand multiply is 50%. FOC cap for PAS 2 is ScaleDoubleByPowerTwo(-n) via pas2_foc_scale (stock n=1 → half of max current), not this byte.

pas3_percent.label: PAS 3 assist
pas3_percent.summary: How hard PAS 3 pulls from the torque sensor (stock 70%). Raise for more help on level 3.
pas3_percent.notes: Torque-demand multiply is 70%. FOC cap is soft-float 0.8; the high word at 0x10002FD8 is PAS 3 FOC scale. PAS 1/3 still share mantissa 0x9999999A.

pas4_percent.label: PAS 4 assist
pas4_percent.summary: How hard PAS 4 pulls from the torque sensor (stock 85%). Raise for more help on level 4.
pas4_percent.notes: Torque-demand multiply is 85%. FOC cap is a separate soft-float 0.9 at 0x10002FDC (PAS 4 FOC scale).

pas5_percent.label: PAS 5 assist
pas5_percent.summary: Strongest pedal-assist level, not walk. Stock is already 100% of the torque-sensor demand.
pas5_percent.notes: Strongest pedal-assist percent (not walk). Torque-demand multiply is 100%. FOC cap copies the max-current setpoint unscaled.

walk_assist_target.label: Walk-assist target
walk_assist_target.summary: How hard walk-assist pushes (stock 450 firmware units). Does not change how you enter walk on the display, only the current while walk is on.
walk_assist_target.notes: RunRideControlLoop when PAS==6: movs r0,#255; adds r0,#imm; strh to ride-state+0x12. Stock 0xC3 gives 450. Then the shared ble clamps cap it against g_wAssistCurrentTarget, which ApplyAssistLevelTargets set to walk_assist_fraction_sixteenths of g_wFullCurrentLimit (stock 3/16). If that fraction of the ride current clamp is below this target, walk cannot reach it.

torque_engage_deadband.label: Torque engage deadband
torque_engage_deadband.summary: PAS starts only when live torque ADC is above the learned offset plus this (stock 163). Too low twitches at rest; too high feels late.
torque_engage_deadband.notes: CalculateTorqueAssistCurrent: adds r7,#imm then cmp live ADC. A flag / +0x50>30 path can still engage inside the deadband. Unique adds r7,#0xA3.

torque_assist_demand_floor.label: PAS demand floor
torque_assist_demand_floor.summary: Minimum torque-assist demand after the PAS percent multiply (stock 300). Separate from the FOC slew floor of 300.
torque_assist_demand_floor.notes: CalculateTorqueAssistCurrent: movs r2,#255; adds r2,#imm; if g_bAssistPercent * filtered_demand < that, store 300 to 0x20002718. The mapped torque slew floor at 0x10008F9C uses the same 255+0x2D encoding in ProcessTorqueCurrentSlewLimit.

unlimit_speed_display_60.label: Unlimit speed when display sends 60 km/h
unlimit_speed_display_60.summary: Force display TX bit 0x40000 always on so the VD04 handshake is not stuck in legal 25/PAS 1, and remap fade math from 60 to 99 when the display sends 60. Motor taper is the 60→99 remap unless Disable speed fade is also on (that skips Apply taper in both display modes).
unlimit_speed_display_60.notes: Site 0x10008824 is bcc→b so UpdateDisplayWheelPeriodStatusBit always ORs 0x40000 into the display TX word (same handshake as donor patched HEX). Clearing that bit at standstill keeps the VD04 in legal PAS-1 / 25 km/h so it never sends 60. Site 0x10008826 (protect-bit test) stays stock. Site 0x10008890 remaps a live display 60 to 99 in RebuildWheelSpeedFadeThresholds. Does not disable fade; it moves the taper point. Disable speed fade patches ApplyWheelSpeedFade separately and does not overwrite this remap. Short b is scatter/RAM-safe.

disable_speed_fade.label: Disable speed fade
disable_speed_fade.summary: Skip the near-cap assist taper in ApplyWheelSpeedFade on both display 25 and 60. PAS percent, ride-current clamp, thermal, battery, and protect limits still apply.
disable_speed_fade.notes: ApplyWheelSpeedFade is scatter-copied with the rest of the ride window to SRAM, so these short b encodings stay valid after the RAM copy. Site 0x100088F6 is bcs→b to 0x10008916 (always store full assist span; stock bcs 0x100088fe is 02 D2). Site 0x10008922 is bcs→b to 0x1000893e (always keep source current; stock bcs 0x1000892c is 03 D2). Same two sites as donor patched HEX. Does not patch RebuildWheelSpeedFadeThresholds; Unlimit-when-display-60 still owns the handshake and 60→99 remap. 0x10008904 stays stock. Not literally full motor power — other limiters remain. On-road 25 and off-road 60 both skip motor fade.

skip_throttle_lockout_bit.label: Skip throttle assist-bit lockout
skip_throttle_lockout_bit.summary: Let the analog throttle map run even when dwAssistBits 0x40000 is set. That lockout bit is not the display TX 0x40000 handshake. PAS 0 still skips throttle.
skip_throttle_lockout_bit.notes: RunRideControlLoop at 0x1000330C is bmi skip after lsls dwAssistBits #13 (bit 18 = 0x40000 on 0x20002690). UpdateThrottleAdcWatchdog sets that bit when ADC > ~849 while the age counter is 6–159, and clears it only if ADC < 840. A rest ADC of 850–1200 latches the lockout so twist never stages (ADC−600)×2+800. Nop (00 BF) leaves the ADC window and PAS≠0 tests. Display TX bit 0x40000 at 0x20002B00 is a different word. If rest ADC is already above 840 after lowering the window floors, idle is treated as throttle-on — raise throttle_lockout_release and the three window floors together.

ride_current_clamp.label: Ride current clamp
ride_current_clamp.summary: Upper clamp on ride-loop current (throttle and PAS). 0 keeps the stock 6200 firmware-unit convert. 32767 is signed-16 max so the analog throttle map is not cut while the ble still bounds demand.
ride_current_clamp.notes: ComputeMotorScaleTables: stock converts the fixed float 6200.0 at 0x10003A44 (scale base+0x98) via ConvertFloatToSignedInt into g_wFullCurrentLimit (0x200025E2). That is a constant, not a pack-current-derived value. PAS 1–5 copies that word into g_wAssistCurrentTarget, then RunRideControlLoop ble-clamps wCurrentTarget to both. 0 leaves the convert. 450–32767 replaces the six bytes with movs r0,#hi; lsls #8; adds #lo so the ble still runs. Skipping those ble instructions lets throttle stage (ADC-600)*2+800 unbounded and the motor twitches. Walk’s +0x12 450 immediate is separate. Can overheat the controller.

throttle_adc_low.label: Throttle ADC low edge
throttle_adc_low.summary: Low edge of the analog throttle window as a signed offset (stock −1241). The live window is abs(this) through abs(this)+span. Shared with the PAS-full override path.
throttle_adc_low.notes: RunRideControlLoop: adc + this literal is compared to throttle_adc_span (stock 2359) so 1241 ≤ ADC < 3600. The same −1241 word is also loaded by ApplyAssistLevelTargets for the PAS-full override (span throttle_pas_full_span 2679 → ADC < 3920). A second −1241 at 0x100089B8 is fade_throttle_adc_low (ApplyWheelSpeedFade) and is not this slider.

throttle_adc_span.label: Throttle ADC span
throttle_adc_span.summary: Width of the analog throttle window (stock 2359). High ADC = abs(low edge) + span, so stock is 1241+2359 = 3600. Unique literal; 3600 is not stored.
throttle_adc_span.notes: RunRideControlLoop unsigned compare after adding throttle_adc_low. One xref. The PAS-full override uses throttle_pas_full_span 2679 at 0x100033E8, not this word.

throttle_adc_offset.label: Throttle ADC offset
throttle_adc_offset.summary: Subtracted from averaged throttle ADC before the ×2 gain (stock 600). Formula is (ADC − offset)×2 + bias.
throttle_adc_offset.notes: RunRideControlLoop: unique movs r0,#imm; lsls #3 at 0x10003312. Formula (ADC-offset)×2+bias, then uxth. Max 1240 stays at or below the stock throttle-window low edge so a closed throttle cannot wrap to a huge current. Fade floor and LoadMotorScaleDefaults also use 75<<3 = 600 with different registers; those sites stay put.

throttle_adc_bias.label: Throttle ADC bias
throttle_adc_bias.summary: Added after the throttle ×2 gain (stock 800). Same 25<<5 encoding as the speed wall, but this movs is r0 not r3.
throttle_adc_bias.notes: RunRideControlLoop unique 19 20 40 01. The 800-tick timeout and torque-path 25<<5 use 19 21 49 01 and are fingerprint-locked.

pwm_idle_shutdown_ticks.label: PWM idle shutdown
pwm_idle_shutdown_ticks.summary: How long ride-loop current can stay at zero before PWM is shut down (stock 200 ticks). Lower drops the motor sooner at a stop.
pwm_idle_shutdown_ticks.notes: RunRideControlLoop: sxth then cmp r0,#imm; blt keep running. At the trip: RAM thunk, CCU OR 0xC00, clear protect/assist bits. A second cmp #0xC8 at 0x10007E96 is Ride protect timeout; a third at 0x100087AC is the throttle-ADC watchdog age saturate. Those are separate sliders.

fade_assist_floor.label: Speed-fade assist floor
fade_assist_floor.summary: Minimum assist left when speed-fade cuts near/over the cap (stock 600). Raise to keep more power as you near the limit; unused if Disable speed fade is on.
fade_assist_floor.notes: ApplyWheelSpeedFade: movs r6,#imm; lsls #3. Stock 75<<3 = 600. Applied when live wheel period is below the fade-at-cap threshold (smaller period = faster / at-or-over the speed cap), and as the +600 term in the fade interpolate. Not a low-speed floor. Skipped while PAS==6. Left-shift is fingerprint-locked.

thermal_protect_low_band.label: Thermal protect low band
thermal_protect_low_band.summary: Averaged NTC percent that clears thermal protect when strictly below this (stock 75). Not a current-shunt ADC.
thermal_protect_low_band.notes: RunRideControlLoop averages LookupTemperatureAdcPercent (not a shunt ADC). Clear-protect is strict less-than this cmp; equal to 75 stays in the interpolate band. Keep this below Thermal protect high band. The interpolate is (high-T)*cell>>4, so the stock 16-wide gap (91-75) is hard-wired; moving only one band makes the ramp discontinuous. High NTC ADC ≥944 forces percent 60, which sits in this clear-protect band.

thermal_protect_high_band.label: Thermal protect high band
thermal_protect_high_band.summary: Upper reference of the thermal fade band (stock 91). Fade already runs from the low band through this value; ≥92 enters the countdown/trip path.
thermal_protect_high_band.notes: RunRideControlLoop: both cmp #imm sites (0x1000353A / 0x10003558). Ramp operates from thermal_protect_low_band through this high reference; equality stays in the fade band. Values above this enter the protect countdown.

torque_min_current_floor.label: Torque slew current floor
torque_min_current_floor.summary: Minimum FOC current during the torque slew window (stock 300). Raise for a stronger floor while torque is ramping.
torque_min_current_floor.notes: ProcessTorqueCurrentSlewLimit: movs r0,#255; adds r0,#imm; if foc-state+0x10 < that, clamp to it. Stock 255+0x2D = 300. Assist floor during the slew window.

torque_slew_sample_timeout.label: Torque slew timeout
torque_slew_sample_timeout.summary: How many samples the torque slew may run before it aborts and restores the saved motor angle (stock 50).
torque_slew_sample_timeout.notes: ProcessTorqueCurrentSlewLimit: abort after sample index > this cmp; clears flag bit 4 and restores the saved electrical angle. Stock 50. The same count cell is also capped by a RAM window from ComputeMotorScaleTables (0x200025DC); this timeout only fires if that window is above this value.

pll_rate_clamp_high.label: PLL rate clamp high
pll_rate_clamp_high.summary: Upper limit on the motor’s electrical-speed tracker (stock 2400). Wrong values can make the FOC loop hunt or lose lock.
pll_rate_clamp_high.notes: ProcessParkCurrentPiLoop: movs r2,#imm; lsls #5. Upper clamp on the PLL/electrical-rate cell. Stock 75<<5 = 2400. Asymmetric vs the -1024 low clamp.

pll_rate_clamp_low.label: PLL rate clamp low
pll_rate_clamp_low.summary: Lower limit on the same electrical-speed tracker (stock −1024). Pair with the high clamp; do not set this to a large positive number.
pll_rate_clamp_low.notes: Literal int32 0xFFFFFC00. Lower clamp on the same PLL/electrical-rate cell as pll_rate_clamp_high.

stall_current_mag_sq.label: Stall mag-squared
stall_current_mag_sq.summary: Dead sensorless path: would trip when raw Clarke mag² is below this (stock 20000). Patching has no effect on stock.
stall_current_mag_sq.notes: HandleUnreachableSvmStallProtect at 0x10009310: if raw Clarke mag² at 0x20002AEC < this literal, equalize PWM. Reconfirmed unreachable after scatter-load/RAM-alias scan. Unrelated 20000 at 0x10002F84 is battery logic.

stall_phase_balance_count.label: Stall phase-balance count
stall_phase_balance_count.summary: Dead sensorless path: phase-balance counter trip (stock 32000). Patching has no effect on stock.
stall_phase_balance_count.notes: HandleUnreachableSvmStallProtect: trips with mag² path when phase-balance count >= imm<<8 (stock 0x7D<<8 = 32000). Reconfirmed unreachable after RAM-alias scan — keep only for experiments on alternate images.

hall_angle_offset.label: Hall angle offset
hall_angle_offset.summary: Rotates the hall-sensor electrical angle by 30° stock (Q16 0x1555). Not a speed or power knob. Wrong values make the motor noisy, weak, or jerk.
hall_angle_offset.notes: HandleHallSixStepCommutation adds this literal to LookupHallCommutationAngle. Stock 0x1555 = 65536/12 = 30 electrical degrees. The hall sector table at 0x1000722C steps by 0x2AAA (60°); 60° here would be 0x2AAB. Copies at 0x100025B4 (enable path) and 0x10009048 (ProcessHallAngleAdvance) are patched together so commutation stays in sync.

clarke_mag_iir_new.label: Clarke mag IIR (new)
clarke_mag_iir_new.summary: Dead Clarke IIR: Q15 weight on the new mag² sample (stock 2768). Patching has no effect on stock.
clarke_mag_iir_new.notes: HandleUnreachableClarkePhaseCurrents: movs #imm; lsls #4 Q15 new-weight (stock 0xAD<<4 = 2768). Complementary prev-weight 30000 is fingerprint-locked. Reconfirmed unreachable after RAM-alias scan.

throttle_pas_full_span.label: PAS-full throttle span
throttle_pas_full_span.summary: Width of the throttle window that forces PAS 1–5 to full current (stock 2679). High ADC = abs(low edge) + this span, so stock is 1241+2679 = 3920.
throttle_pas_full_span.notes: ApplyAssistLevelTargets: adc + throttle_adc_low compared to this unique literal. One xref. Walk and PAS 0 skip the override. Separate from the analog throttle map span 2359.

uart_min_display_speed_kmh.label: Display speed accept floor
uart_min_display_speed_kmh.summary: Display max-speed byte is stored when it is greater than this (stock 10), or when the wheel-size code also changes past uart_min_wheel_code. Silent displays keep the init defaults.
uart_min_display_speed_kmh.notes: ParseDisplayUartFrame: speed is written to 0x20002705 when speed > this OR when the wheel code changed and is above uart_min_wheel_code. Not a hard reject of every frame with speed ≤10.

ride_target_fade_delta.label: Wheel-period slew threshold
ride_target_fade_delta.summary: When |delta| exceeds this, SmoothWheelPeriodTargetWord also applies the bulk asrs step before the fine ±1 (stock 16). Smaller values track pulse-period changes more aggressively.
ride_target_fade_delta.notes: SmoothWheelPeriodTargetWord: both cmp #imm sites at 0x100089E4 / 0x10008A00. When |delta| > this, the filter first steps by delta>>N (see fade_period_slew_shift); afterward it always moves ±1 toward the target. Stock cmp is 16, not 2^N−1, so threshold and shift are independent sliders.

fade_period_slew_shift.label: Wheel-period slew shift
fade_period_slew_shift.summary: Bulk step size for SmoothWheelPeriodTargetWord when |delta| exceeds the slew threshold (stock N=4 → delta>>4).
fade_period_slew_shift.notes: SmoothWheelPeriodTargetWord: both asrs r3,#N sites at 0x100089E8 / 0x10008A04. Smaller N tracks wheel-pulse period changes faster (less filtering). Independent of ride_target_fade_delta because stock threshold 16 is not 2^N−1.

ntc_adc_overrange.label: NTC ADC overrange
ntc_adc_overrange.summary: NTC ADC at or above this forces the lookup percent to the overrange value (stock 944). Capped at stock so hotter ADCs cannot skip the overrange percent.
ntc_adc_overrange.notes: LookupTemperatureAdcPercent: movs r1,#imm; lsls #4; if adc >= that, return the forced percent. Stock 0x3B<<4 = 944. Raising this above 944 lets ADCs between the old and new threshold fall through the table. The left-shift is fingerprint-locked.

ntc_overrange_forced_percent.label: NTC overrange percent
ntc_overrange_forced_percent.summary: Percent written when NTC ADC is overrange (stock 60). Stock 60 sits in the thermal clear-protect band.
ntc_overrange_forced_percent.notes: LookupTemperatureAdcPercent: movs r0,#imm after the 944 compare. Unique. Keep this in mind vs Thermal protect low/high bands.

ride_protect_timeout_ticks.label: UART silence protect timeout
ride_protect_timeout_ticks.summary: UART-silence counter at 0x200025A4 trips after this many ticks (stock 200). Separate from PWM idle shutdown and the throttle-ADC watchdog age saturate, which also use #0xC8.
ride_protect_timeout_ticks.notes: IncrementUartSilenceProtectCounter ages 0x200025A4. cmp r0,#imm; above this, bit20 of 0x20002694 is cleared. Same immediate as PWM idle and UpdateThrottleAdcWatchdog age saturate; different RAM cell.

pas4_foc_scale.label: PAS 4 FOC scale
pas4_foc_scale.summary: FOC current cap for PAS 4 as a percent of max current (stock 90%). Independent IEEE double. PAS 1/3 high words are separate sliders; they share mantissa low-word 0x9999999A. PAS 2 is a shift, not a data word.
pas4_foc_scale.notes: ApplyAssistLevelTargets PAS==4 multiplies max current by this little-endian double (stock 0.9). At stock 22 A the 6200 ride-current clamp already sits below 0.9× the derived ceiling, so this slider is inert until Ride current clamp is raised. Do not confuse with PAS 4 assist percent 85.

throttle_adc_watchdog_age.label: Throttle-ADC watchdog age
throttle_adc_watchdog_age.summary: How long the throttle-ADC watchdog age byte may increment before it saturates (stock 200). Keep at or above 160 so the lockout window can still close.
throttle_adc_watchdog_age.notes: UpdateThrottleAdcWatchdog reads the throttle ADC cell 0x20002528. If the age byte < imm, increment. Third cmp #0xC8 in the image. Values below ~160 can leave the throttle lockout window open.

throttle_adc_fault_age.label: Throttle-ADC fault age
throttle_adc_fault_age.summary: Debounce for throttle ADC stuck above Throttle overrange (stock 100 ticks). Not a stale/missing-sample timer.
throttle_adc_fault_age.notes: UpdateThrottleAdcWatchdog: cmp r0,#imm after the overrange age. Writes dwAssistBits 0x40000 on 0x20002690 when ADC > throttle_overrange for this many ticks. Not a missing-sample / stale-ADC timer.

battery_voltage_window.label: Battery voltage window
battery_voltage_window.summary: OV-clear and UV-trip offset (stock 32 counts ≈ 0.68 V). Both subtract sites stay in sync.
battery_voltage_window.notes: UpdateBatteryVoltageMonitor: subs vs the over-voltage threshold at 0x10002DAC and vs the under-voltage threshold at 0x10002DC2. Not a current limiter. Skip battery voltage guards skips the flag branches but does not rewrite these immediates.

battery_uv_recovery.label: Battery UV recovery
battery_uv_recovery.summary: Added to the under-voltage threshold before clearing the UV latch (stock 93 counts ≈ 1.99 V).
battery_uv_recovery.notes: UpdateBatteryVoltageMonitor: adds r0,#imm then cmp the averaged pack-voltage ADC. Unique adds #0x5D.

wheel_pulse_high_timeout.label: Wheel-pulse stuck-high timeout
wheel_pulse_high_timeout.summary: How long the P0.4 wheel-speed pin can stay high before the firmware treats the wheel as stopped (stock 2000 ticks).
wheel_pulse_high_timeout.notes: UpdateWheelPulsePeriod: if P0.4 high-time > imm<<4, period saturates to the stopped value. Stock 0x7D<<4 = 2000. Falling edges also call ApplyWheelSpeedFade.

wheel_pulse_stopped_period.label: Wheel-pulse stopped period
wheel_pulse_stopped_period.summary: Period written when the P0.4 wheel-speed pin looks stopped (stock 4100). Larger means it waits longer before calling the wheel stopped.
wheel_pulse_stopped_period.notes: Literal 0x00001004 used by UpdateWheelPulsePeriod. Low-time counter saturates here and the same value is written as the stopped period. The committed period is stored as period<<2 into a uint16, so values above 16383 wrap. This cell is also the UpdateDisplayWheelPeriodStatusBit operand.

wheel_pulse_min_high_ticks.label: Wheel-pulse min high-time
wheel_pulse_min_high_ticks.summary: Ignore very short P0.4 pulses (noise). Stock needs more than 7 ticks of high time before a wheel pulse counts.
wheel_pulse_min_high_ticks.notes: UpdateWheelPulsePeriod: falling-edge period is committed only if high-time > this cmp. Stock 7 means a committed pulse needs at least 8 ticks.

long_period_sample_gate_kmh.label: Long-period sample gate
long_period_sample_gate_kmh.summary: Increments a sample counter when the P0.4 wheel-pulse period is longer than this value<<5 (stock 125 → 4000 ticks). Stopped saturate is 4100, so stock only counts near-stopped pulses. Encoded like the display-status period threshold, not a km/h wall. No external reader of the counter has been found — likely inert in stock.
long_period_sample_gate_kmh.notes: CountLongWheelPulsePeriodSamples: movs r3,#imm; lsls #5 vs 0x20002590 (same period cell as Speed ceiling). Increments when period > threshold AND protect-bit<<29 is negative AND the sample-cap is not full. Counter at 0x200025C8 is only read/written here and zeroed by UpdateWheelPulsePeriod; no other recovered consumer (including RAM-aliased code). The left-shift is fingerprint-locked. Id suffix _kmh is historical; unit is period ticks after <<5.

long_period_sample_cap.label: Long-period sample cap
long_period_sample_cap.summary: How many long-period samples that counter may accumulate (stock 1000). Caps CountLongWheelPulsePeriodSamples. Likely inert — no external reader of the counter has been found.
long_period_sample_cap.notes: CountLongWheelPulsePeriodSamples: movs r2,#imm; lsls #3. Stock 0x7D<<3 = 1000. Same counter as long_period_sample_gate_kmh (0x200025C8); no recovered consumer outside this function. The left-shift is fingerprint-locked.

skip_battery_voltage_guards.label: Bypass battery OV/UV flag branches
skip_battery_voltage_guards.summary: Skip the battery over/under-voltage flag branches. The third site forces the raise path, but when avg is still below UV the limit can still fold back via (avg−UV)×2.
skip_battery_voltage_guards.notes: UpdateBatteryVoltageMonitor: three branch rewrites (0x10002DA4, 0x10002DC8, 0x10002E12). The first two bypass OV/UV flag stores. The third does not fully skip low-voltage foldback: forcing the raise path while avg < UV still adds (avg−UV)×2 and can wind the limit down. Soft window/recovery sliders still apply on unpatched builds.

throttle_lockout_release.label: Throttle lockout release
throttle_lockout_release.summary: Clears the throttle lockout when throttle ADC is below this (stock 840). Raise if a resting aftermarket throttle sits above 840 and never unlocks.
throttle_lockout_release.notes: UpdateThrottleAdcWatchdog: movs r3,#imm; lsls #3 then cmp the throttle ADC at 0x20002528. Stock 0x69<<3 = 840. Else-if ADC < 840 clears assist bit 0x40000. Unique movs. The lsls #3 is fingerprint-locked.

throttle_overrange.label: Throttle overrange
throttle_overrange.summary: Stuck-high throttle ADC threshold (stock 3686). Above this the watchdog ages toward the fault bit.
throttle_overrange.notes: UpdateThrottleAdcWatchdog unique literal DAT_10008998. If throttle ADC > this, the second age counter increments and at throttle_adc_fault_age sets dwAssistBits 0x40000. 12-bit ADC tops out at 4095.

speed_fade_band_numerator.label: Speed-fade band numerator
speed_fade_band_numerator.summary: Fade-low = fade-high x numerator / divisor (stock 25). With stock 22 this starts the taper at cap x 22/25.
speed_fade_band_numerator.notes: RebuildWheelSpeedFadeThresholds: movs r1,#imm then muls fade-high, then divide by speed_fade_band_divisor. Unique 19 21 at 0x100088AC. Not the ceiling movs r3,#0x19 or the torque-path 25<<5.

speed_fade_band_divisor.label: Speed-fade band divisor
speed_fade_band_divisor.summary: Divisor of the fade-low rebuild (stock 22). Lower starts the taper sooner; 0 would fault the unsigned divide.
speed_fade_band_divisor.notes: RebuildWheelSpeedFadeThresholds unique movs r1,#0x16 at 0x100088B0 after muls r0,r1. Pair with speed_fade_band_numerator. The muls 48 43 is fingerprint-locked.

brake_debounce_depth.label: Brake debounce depth
brake_debounce_depth.summary: How many matching samples DebounceBrakeInput needs before the lever is taken as pressed (stock 3, so 4 stable reads).
brake_debounce_depth.notes: DebounceBrakeInput: cmp r1,#imm; if count > imm return the latched level. Unique cmp #3. Lower trips faster; higher ignores short glitches. Active-low PORT0.10.

pas1_foc_scale.label: PAS 1 FOC scale
pas1_foc_scale.summary: FOC current cap for PAS 1 as a percent of max current (stock 40%). High word only; shared mantissa 0x9999999A is locked. Valid percents are 10/20/40/80/160.
pas1_foc_scale.notes: ApplyAssistLevelTargets PAS==1 multiplies max current by the double (mantissa at 0x10002FD0, this high word). Not the PAS 1 assist percent 30. Encoding rejects values whose IEEE low word would differ from the shared mantissa. At stock 22 A / 6200 clamp this 40% cap is the live PAS 1 FOC ceiling; PAS 3/4 stay clamp-limited.

pas3_foc_scale.label: PAS 3 FOC scale
pas3_foc_scale.summary: FOC current cap for PAS 3 as a percent of max current (stock 80%). High word only; shared mantissa 0x9999999A is locked. Valid percents are 10/20/40/80/160.
pas3_foc_scale.notes: ApplyAssistLevelTargets PAS==3 uses (DAT_10002fd0, this word). Independent of pas1_foc_scale aside from the locked mantissa. At stock 22 A the 6200 ride-current clamp already sits below 0.8× the derived ceiling, so raising this is inert until Ride current clamp is raised.

pack_uv_cutoff_v.label: Pack UV cutoff
pack_uv_cutoff_v.summary: Pack under-voltage cutoff copied by LoadMotorScaleDefaults (stock 41.0 V). Soft foldback plus hard UV still use the ADC window/recovery sliders.
pack_uv_cutoff_v.notes: Float32 41.0 at 0x10003A24; unique ldr from LoadMotorScaleDefaults into the scale table. UpdateBatteryVoltageMonitor compares averaged pack ADC against the derived UV threshold. Pair with Battery voltage window (+/-32 counts) and Battery UV recovery (+93).

pack_nominal_v.label: Pack nominal voltage
pack_nominal_v.summary: Nominal pack voltage used as the Q14 voltage-ratio divisor (stock 48.0 V). Keep this near the real pack; far values skew every derived current limit.
pack_nominal_v.notes: Float32 48.0 at 0x10003A10; unique ldr in LoadMotorScaleDefaults. ComputeDerivedScaleTables / UpdateBatteryVoltageMonitor divide avg<<14 by the 48 V scale. Narrow band because it feeds many derived cells.

pack_max_current_a.label: Pack max current
pack_max_current_a.summary: Scale-table max current setpoint (stock 22.0 A). High risk: derived signed-16 cells wrap above ~71 A. Can overheat the controller.
pack_max_current_a.notes: Float32 22.0 at 0x10003A18; unique ldr in LoadMotorScaleDefaults into the scale table. ComputeMotorScaleTables converts it into g_wMaxCurrentSetpoint (stock ≈10147 counts; sxth wraps above ~71 A). Cap 30 A stays well under the wrap. Ride current clamp is a separate int16 override from the fixed 6200.0 float. Raising this alone mainly lifts PAS FOC caps that are fractions of max current; the ride-loop 6200 clamp still binds until Ride current clamp is raised.

torque_sensor_gain_eighths.label: Torque sensor gain
torque_sensor_gain_eighths.summary: Scales every PAS torque demand as (delta>>a)+(delta>>b) eighths (stock 3 = 3/8). Must be a sum of two powers of two.
torque_sensor_gain_eighths.notes: CalculateTorqueAssistCurrent: asrs #2 + asrs #3 then adds, stored to the torque-delta cell. Stock 3/8 of (ADC-offset). Encoder writes two Thumb asrs imm5 that sum to this many eighths. Values like 7 (three bits) are rejected.

walk_assist_fraction_sixteenths.label: Walk current fraction
walk_assist_fraction_sixteenths.summary: Walk assist current as this many sixteenths of full current (stock 3 = 3/16). Caps walk when below the 450 walk-assist target.
walk_assist_fraction_sixteenths.notes: ApplyAssistLevelTargets PAS==6: asrs #3 + asrs #4 of g_wFullCurrentLimit into g_wAssistCurrentTarget. Stock 3/16. Inert at stock because 3/16 of 6200 is above the 450 walk target; it only clamps if Ride current clamp is below about 2400. Must be a sum of two powers of two. Separate walk FOC cap walk_foc_scale_sixteenths (stock 1/16 of max current) is independent.

pack_ov_cutoff_v.label: Pack OV cutoff
pack_ov_cutoff_v.summary: Pack over-voltage cutoff copied by LoadMotorScaleDefaults (stock 65.0 V). Unique float; the 64.0f store in the same function is a separate seed.
pack_ov_cutoff_v.notes: Float32 65.0 at 0x10003A28; unique ldr from LoadMotorScaleDefaults. UpdateBatteryVoltageMonitor trips OV using the derived threshold into 0x200025F0. Soft window/recovery sliders still apply. Do not confuse with the hardcoded 64.0f written beside this pool.

overload_cutout_arm_ticks.label: Overload cutout arm time
overload_cutout_arm_ticks.summary: How long the ride loop must see protect-bit 2 before the shunt overload compare can cut out (stock 800 ticks).
overload_cutout_arm_ticks.notes: RunRideControlLoop: movs r1,#imm; lsls #5; if the 0x200025A8 counter is above that AND shunt > 641+overload_cutout_margin, set dwAssistBits bit 2 and DisableMotorOutput. Left-shift is fingerprint-locked. Pair with Pack max current.

overload_cutout_margin.label: Overload cutout margin
overload_cutout_margin.summary: Added to the 641 baseline before overload cutout (stock 49 → first trip at 691). Units are the 8-sample shunt average cell, not proven amperes.
overload_cutout_margin.notes: RunRideControlLoop unique adds r1,#imm onto literal 641 at 0x10003438. Strict compare is 641+this < cell at 0x20002584 (8-sample average from CalculateTwoShuntPhaseCurrents; display current byte is that cell>>6). Stock first trips at 691. Max imm 255 → trip at 896 counts. Ampere equivalence is unverified — do not treat this as a calibrated amp slider. Does not rewrite the 22.0 A scale-table float.

throttle_ramp_down_bulk_threshold.label: Throttle ramp-down bulk threshold
throttle_ramp_down_bulk_threshold.summary: Downward throttle-target errors larger than this use the bulk asrs path instead of −1 per tick (stock 15).
throttle_ramp_down_bulk_threshold.notes: RunRideControlLoop throttle slew: cmp r2,#imm before asrs. Pair with throttle_ramp_down_shift so the threshold stays near 2^N−1 for a smooth hand-off.

throttle_ramp_down_shift.label: Throttle ramp-down shift
throttle_ramp_down_shift.summary: Bulk throttle ramp-down step is delta>>N when above the bulk threshold (stock N=4 → /16).
throttle_ramp_down_shift.notes: RunRideControlLoop throttle path: asrs r2,#N after cmp vs throttle_ramp_down_bulk_threshold. Larger N = slower release. Keep the bulk threshold near 2^N−1.

throttle_ramp_up_bulk_threshold.label: Throttle ramp-up bulk threshold
throttle_ramp_up_bulk_threshold.summary: Upward throttle-target errors larger than this use the bulk asrs path instead of +1 per tick (stock 31).
throttle_ramp_up_bulk_threshold.notes: RunRideControlLoop throttle slew: cmp r2,#imm before asrs. Pair with throttle_ramp_up_shift so the threshold stays near 2^N−1 for a smooth hand-off.

throttle_ramp_up_shift.label: Throttle ramp-up shift
throttle_ramp_up_shift.summary: Bulk throttle ramp-up step is delta>>N when above the bulk threshold (stock N=5 → /32).
throttle_ramp_up_shift.notes: RunRideControlLoop throttle path: asrs r2,#N after cmp vs throttle_ramp_up_bulk_threshold. Smaller N = snappier throttle. Keep the bulk threshold near 2^N−1.

current_headroom_deadband.label: Current headroom deadband
current_headroom_deadband.summary: Current limit must exceed measured current by this before headroom steps are generated (stock 70).
current_headroom_deadband.notes: UpdateCurrentHeadroomSlew: adds #imm and matching subs #imm sites (0x10002A38 / 0x10002A42). Headroom steps = (limit-measured-imm)>>5 when limit > measured+imm.

current_headroom_slew_cap.label: Current headroom slew cap
current_headroom_slew_cap.notes: UpdateCurrentHeadroomSlew: cmp #imm and movs #imm clamp sites (0x10002A7A / 0x10002A7E). Patched together so the compare and the saturating store stay equal.

uart_min_wheel_code.label: Display wheel-code accept floor
uart_min_wheel_code.summary: Changed wheel-size codes are accepted only when greater than this (stock 5). Pair with the display speed accept floor.
uart_min_wheel_code.notes: ParseDisplayUartFrame: cmp wheel_code,#imm before storing live wheel/speed. A changed valid wheel code also opens the speed-store path even when speed ≤ uart_min_display_speed_kmh.

walk_foc_scale_sixteenths.label: Walk FOC scale
walk_foc_scale_sixteenths.summary: Walk FOC current cap as a power-of-two fraction of max current in sixteenths (stock 1 = 1/16). Independent of the walk ride-current fraction.
walk_foc_scale_sixteenths.notes: ApplyAssistLevelTargets PAS==6: lsls r0,#imm; lsrs r0,#16 of g_wMaxCurrentSetpoint into g_wScaledAssist. Stock lsl #12 → >>4 = 1/16. Valid values 1/2/4/8 (lsl 12/13/14/15). Does not change walk_assist_fraction_sixteenths or the 450 walk target.

pas_inactivity_timeout.label: PAS inactivity timeout
pas_inactivity_timeout.summary: Clears cadence timing and the PAS-active assist bit after this many unchanged pedal-sensor samples (stock 1000).
pas_inactivity_timeout.notes: DecodePasCadencePulseEdges: movs r7,#imm; lsls #3; while channel A is unchanged the counter rises to this, then clears timing state and assist bit 0x800. Left-shift is fingerprint-locked.

pas_pulse_timeout.label: PAS pulse timeout
pas_pulse_timeout.summary: Maximum high or low pedal-pulse duration before cadence is invalidated (stock 1500). Trips when the count exceeds this.
pas_pulse_timeout.notes: DecodePasCadencePulseEdges: unique literal compared against both high-time and low-time pulse counters. On trip clears assist bit 0x800 and resets timing words.

pas_engage_pulse_count.label: PAS engage pulse count
pas_engage_pulse_count.summary: Consistent pedal edges required before cadence is accepted (stock 2 → third qualifying edge publishes timing).
pas_engage_pulse_count.notes: DecodePasCadencePulseEdges: cmp r6,#imm on the rising-edge qualifier counter. Below the threshold the counter increments; at/above it publishes pulse timing and sets assist bit 0x800.

torque_adc_rise_window.label: Torque ADC rise window
torque_adc_rise_window.summary: How often DecodePasCadencePulseEdges samples torque-ADC rise into 0x200025A8 (stock 50 ticks).
torque_adc_rise_window.notes: Tail of DecodePasCadencePulseEdges: while the counter != this, increment and return; on equality store max(0, torqueADC−previous) to 0x200025A8 and reset. Feeds torque_slope_engage_delta — not a PAS cadence-edge timer.

torque_offset_drop_threshold.label: Torque offset drop threshold
torque_offset_drop_threshold.summary: If live torque ADC falls more than this below the learned zero, automatic offset relearning starts (stock 80).
torque_offset_drop_threshold.notes: LearnTorqueOffsetAndFaults: if adc < learned && (learned-adc) > imm, the relearn counter advances. Pair with torque_offset_relearn_count.

torque_offset_relearn_count.label: Torque offset relearn count
torque_offset_relearn_count.summary: Consecutive below-offset samples required before the learned torque zero is replaced (stock 100).
torque_offset_relearn_count.notes: LearnTorqueOffsetAndFaults: both cmp #imm sites (0x10007F90 cap, 0x10007F9A apply). Counter must reach this before *learnedOffset = adcSample.

battery_average_sample_count.label: Battery average sample count
battery_average_sample_count.summary: Battery monitor runs when the sample counter reaches this (stock 16). Averaging uses >>4 at stock; large changes desync the shift.
battery_average_sample_count.notes: UpdateBatteryVoltageMonitor: cmp sample_count,#imm before averaging. Stock 16 matches the >>4 mean. Changing far from a power of two without a matching shift rewrite skews the average.

battery_uv_predebounce.label: Battery UV pre-debounce
battery_uv_predebounce.summary: How long average voltage must stay below UV−window before the secondary UV latch counter advances (stock 5).
battery_uv_predebounce.notes: UpdateBatteryVoltageMonitor: first UV debounce cmp #imm after the battery_voltage_window subtract. Pair with battery_uv_latch_threshold.

battery_uv_latch_threshold.label: Battery UV latch threshold
battery_uv_latch_threshold.summary: Secondary UV counter threshold before the under-voltage latch sets (stock 3).
battery_uv_latch_threshold.notes: UpdateBatteryVoltageMonitor: cmp on the secondary UV counter after battery_uv_predebounce. Lower trips UV faster; higher tolerates brief dips.

hall_advance_high_threshold.label: Hall advance high threshold
hall_advance_high_threshold.summary: Hall-rate above which the largest startup hall-angle advance is used (stock 3000).
hall_advance_high_threshold.notes: ProcessHallAngleAdvance first band: if hall rate > this literal, add hall_advance_high. Mid/low thresholds are separate movs<<N sliders; low-band advance amount is coupled to hall_advance_mid_threshold.

hall_advance_high.label: Hall advance high
hall_advance_high.summary: Electrical-angle advance applied above the high threshold (stock 5000 ≈ 27.5°). Wrong values jerk at takeoff.
hall_advance_high.notes: ProcessHallAngleAdvance: added to LookupHallCommutationAngle when hall rate > hall_advance_high_threshold. Q16 turns; 65536 ≈ 360°.

hall_advance_medium.label: Hall advance medium
hall_advance_medium.summary: Electrical-angle advance for the mid hall-rate band (stock 3500 ≈ 19.2°).
hall_advance_medium.notes: ProcessHallAngleAdvance else-branch add when rate is above hall_advance_mid_threshold and not above hall_advance_high_threshold. Low-band +advance shares the mid-threshold immediate.

pas2_foc_scale.label: PAS 2 FOC scale
pas2_foc_scale.summary: PAS 2 FOC current cap as max_current / 2^n (stock 1 → 50%). Uses ScaleDoubleByPowerTwo, not a soft-float data word.
pas2_foc_scale.notes: ApplyAssistLevelTargets PAS==2: movs r2,#(n-1); mvns r2,r2 → ScaleDoubleByPowerTwo(..., -n). Stock movs #0; mvns → -1 → half of max current. Valid n 1–4 (50%/25%/12.5%/6.25%). The mvns halfword is fingerprint-locked. At stock 22 A / 6200 clamp this 50% cap is often the live PAS 2 FOC ceiling.

fade_throttle_adc_low.label: Fade throttle ADC low edge
fade_throttle_adc_low.summary: Low edge of the throttle-in-window test inside ApplyWheelSpeedFade (stock −1241). Separate from the ride-loop Throttle ADC low edge slider.
fade_throttle_adc_low.notes: ApplyWheelSpeedFade unique literal at 0x100089B8. Window is abs(this) through fade_throttle_adc_high. The ride-loop / PAS-full −1241 at 0x100033E4 is throttle_adc_low and is not this word. Raise both when fitting an aftermarket throttle whose rest ADC sits above the stock window.

fade_throttle_adc_high.label: Fade throttle ADC high edge
fade_throttle_adc_high.summary: High edge of the throttle-in-window test inside ApplyWheelSpeedFade (stock 2679 = 2731−52). Aligns with PAS-full throttle span at stock.
fade_throttle_adc_high.notes: ApplyWheelSpeedFade: ldr lit 2731 from 0x10008980 then subs r6,#imm. Stock imm 0x34 → 2679, matching throttle_pas_full_span. The 2731 pool word is also ParseDisplayUartFrame command 0x08 and must stay locked; only this subtract is patched. Effective high = 2731−imm.

protect_assist_clear_ticks.label: Protect assist-bit clear delay
protect_assist_clear_ticks.summary: After overload/protect cutout ends, how long before assist bit 0x20 is cleared (stock 500 ticks).
protect_assist_clear_ticks.notes: RunRideControlLoop: when protect is inactive, counter at 0x200025A8 rises; above 255+imm clears dwAssistBits bit 0x20. Stock 0xF5 → 500. Separate from Overload cutout arm time (800) which gates the trip.

uart_frame_byte0_timeout.label: UART frame byte0 timeout
uart_frame_byte0_timeout.summary: While UART RX buffer byte0 at 0x200025C4 is nonzero, clear it after this many timeslice ticks (stock 1000). Not a motor-stall timer.
uart_frame_byte0_timeout.notes: DispatchMotorControlTimeslice: cell 0x200025C4 is also the ParseDisplayUartFrame RX frame base (byte0 = command index). While nonzero, increment a timer; at >= imm<<3 store 0. Stock 0x7D<<3 = 1000. Formerly mislabeled motor_stall_flag_timeout — no stall relation found. Sensorless Clarke/SVM stall code remains unreachable.

torque_hold_engage_ticks.label: Torque hold engage ticks
torque_hold_engage_ticks.summary: Minimum torque-hold counter before the torque-assist confirm path can run (stock 400).
torque_hold_engage_ticks.notes: UpdateFocHandoverState: movs #255; adds #imm; cmp hold-count. Stock 0x91 → 400. Paired with Torque engage current floor (900) and the locked torque-path 25<<5 speed compare.

torque_engage_current_floor.label: Torque engage current floor
torque_engage_current_floor.summary: Published current target must exceed this before torque-assist confirm advances (stock 900).
torque_engage_current_floor.notes: UpdateFocHandoverState: movs r2,#imm; lsls #2 vs wPublishedCurrentTarget. Stock 0xE1<<2 = 900. Unique movs #0xE1 in this function.

torque_release_period_threshold.label: Torque release FOC product
torque_release_period_threshold.summary: Clears torque-assist bit 0x10 when the FOC Q15 torque product at 0x20002AC0 falls below this (stock 600).
torque_release_period_threshold.notes: UpdateFocHandoverState: movs #0x4B; lsls #3; ldrsh from ProcessFocCurrentControlIsr's Q15 product (torque×scale>>15 at 0x20002AC0). Not a wheel-pulse period. Same 75<<3 encoding as the fade floor but a different site. Id kept for compatibility.

torque_confirm_count.label: Torque confirm count
torque_confirm_count.summary: How many consecutive in-window torque confirms are required before assist bit 0x10 latches (stock 2 → third confirm).
torque_confirm_count.notes: UpdateFocHandoverState: after the event-count gate, increments wTorqueConfirmCount and cmp #imm; when count > imm, clears counters and ors dwAssistBits 0x10. Unique cmp #2 in this function.

torque_event_count_cap.label: Torque event count cap
torque_event_count_cap.summary: Saturating cap on the torque-event counter that must fill before confirm samples run (stock 10).
torque_event_count_cap.notes: UpdateFocHandoverState: cmp #imm and matching movs #imm store (0x1000835C / 0x10008360). Patched together so the compare and the saturating store stay equal. Below the cap the confirm path does not run.

pas_pulse_asymmetry_gate.label: PAS pulse asymmetry gate
pas_pulse_asymmetry_gate.summary: Minimum published high+low pedal period before the asymmetry glitch check can clear cadence (stock 5).
pas_pulse_asymmetry_gate.notes: DecodePasCadencePulseEdges: if (prev_period*2 < high+low) AND (published_period > imm) AND prev_period != 0, clear assist bit 0x800 and timing words. Unique cmp #5 in this function. Lower rejects glitchy PAS edges sooner; higher tolerates uneven magnet spacing.

foc_pi_kp.label: FOC inner PI Kp seed
foc_pi_kp.summary: Proportional gain for the inner d/q current PI blocks at init (stock 400). Not the outer current-loop Kp.
foc_pi_kp.notes: LoadMotorScaleDefaults: movs #255; adds #imm; strh to 0x200025D4. InitializeFocPiControllers copies that halfword into PI blocks A/B Kp. The same register is then lsls #1 into unread 0x200025D8 (800) — patching Kp also changes that dead init word. Outer-loop gain is foc_outer_pi_kp (4864).

foc_pi_ki.label: FOC inner PI Ki seed
foc_pi_ki.summary: Integral gain for the inner d/q current PI blocks at init (stock 2). Not the outer current-loop Ki.
foc_pi_ki.notes: LoadMotorScaleDefaults: movs r2,#imm; strh to unread +2 then later strh to 0x200025D6. InitializeFocPiControllers copies 0x200025D6 into PI blocks A/B Ki. Outer-loop Ki is foc_outer_pi_ki (16).

foc_outer_pi_kp.label: FOC outer PI Kp
foc_outer_pi_kp.summary: Outer current-loop proportional gain (stock 4864 = 0x13<<8 ≈ 1.19 in Q12). Runs about every foc_pi_update_interval ISRs.
foc_outer_pi_kp.notes: LoadMotorScaleDefaults: movs #imm; lsls #8; strh to 0x200025D0. InitializeFocPiControllers copies that into PI block C Kp. ProcessFocCurrentControlIsr calls UpdateFixedPointPiOutput on block C every foc_pi_update_interval. High risk — keep near 50–200% of stock. Separate from foc_pi_kp (inner 400).

foc_outer_pi_ki.label: FOC outer PI Ki
foc_outer_pi_ki.summary: Outer current-loop integral gain (stock 16). Pair with FOC outer PI Kp.
foc_outer_pi_ki.notes: LoadMotorScaleDefaults: movs #imm; strh to 0x200025D2. InitializeFocPiControllers copies into PI block C Ki. Same ~1 kHz path as foc_outer_pi_kp. Raising winds the outer integrator faster; keep small relative to Kp.

foc_vq_limit_floor.label: FOC Vq limit floor
foc_vq_limit_floor.summary: While SVM is saturated, the q-axis voltage clamp walks down 1 count per PWM period to this floor (stock 3000). 4095 disables the walk-down.
foc_vq_limit_floor.notes: CalculateFocParkInverseSvm: when status bit29 is set (ComputeSpaceVectorPwmDuties over-modulation), if Vq limit > this, subtract 1/ISR; else grow toward 4095. Bit29 is set/cleared live. Ceiling literal 0xfff matches the init limit and is not exposed.

pwm_rearm_delay_isr_ticks.label: PWM re-arm delay
pwm_rearm_delay_isr_ticks.summary: ISR ticks that must elapse after PWM disable before EnableMotorPwmWhenReady may re-enable (stock 6000 ≈ 0.38 s at 15.6 kHz).
pwm_rearm_delay_isr_ticks.notes: EnableMotorPwmWhenReady: enable only when counter 0x200025E0 > this literal. Counter zeroes in DisableMotorOutput and increments once per FOC ISR, saturating at 16000. Must stay below 16000 or PWM never re-arms.

hall_torque_sample_limit.label: Hall torque-angle sample limit
hall_torque_sample_limit.summary: How long ProcessHallAngleAdvance may stay in the torque-advance path before forcing a hall re-latch (stock 4000).
hall_torque_sample_limit.notes: LoadMotorScaleDefaults: movs #imm; lsls #5; strh to 0x200025DC. ProcessHallAngleAdvance (live FOC ISR callee) compares the sample counter to that halfword and, when exceeded, re-reads hall bits, ApplyHallSectorPwmPattern, and reapplies hall_angle_offset. Sibling unread scale halfwords 800/600 at +0xC/+0xE have zero recovered readers and are not exposed.

motor_running_current_floor.label: Motor-running current floor
motor_running_current_floor.summary: Filtered shunt-current average at 0x20002584 must be strictly above this before the motor-running debounce can count up (stock 600).
motor_running_current_floor.notes: UpdateMotorRunningDebounce: movs #imm; lsls #3; cmp r4,r7; ble skip — arming requires current > floor (signed), not >=. Cell 0x20002584 is the 8-sample shunt average from CalculateTwoShuntPhaseCurrents (also zeroed on PWM enable/disable). UpdateDisplayWheelPeriodStatusBit additionally asrs>>6 the same halfword into a display TX speed byte — it is not a wheel-pulse period. Pair with motor_running_period_gate.

motor_running_period_gate.label: Motor-running period gate
motor_running_period_gate.summary: P0.4 wheel-pulse period must stay below this for the motor-running flag to arm (stock 4000). Debounce depth is this value >> 3 (stock 500).
motor_running_period_gate.notes: UpdateMotorRunningDebounce: movs #imm; lsls #5 vs 0x20002590 (same period cell as Speed ceiling / Long-period gate). The arming debounce compare uses asrs of the same register (imm<<5>>3 = imm<<2; stock 500). Patching this therefore scales both the period gate and the debounce depth together. Near the stopped saturate 4100.

foc_pi_update_interval.label: FOC PI update interval
foc_pi_update_interval.summary: How many FOC ISR loops between fixed-point PI updates (stock 16).
foc_pi_update_interval.notes: ProcessFocCurrentControlIsr: loop counter at motor-state+0x10; when >= this, reset and call UpdateFixedPointPiOutput. Lower updates the outer PI more often (more CPU).

foc_duty_bulk_step_threshold.label: FOC duty bulk-step threshold
foc_duty_bulk_step_threshold.summary: Upward FOC duty errors larger than this step by delta>>5 instead of +1 (stock 31).
foc_duty_bulk_step_threshold.notes: ProcessFocCurrentControlIsr: cmp duty-delta,#imm; bls fine +1 path, else lsrs #5 bulk path. Sibling of the throttle ramp-up bulk threshold but on the FOC duty integrator.

torque_sensor_fault_adc_low.label: Torque sensor fault ADC low
torque_sensor_fault_adc_low.summary: Torque ADC below this after the learn delay sets sensor-fault bit 2 / error 6 and cancels assist (stock 245).
torque_sensor_fault_adc_low.notes: LearnTorqueOffsetAndFaults / LearnTorqueOffsetAndFaults: after sample count > 0x5F0, cmp adc,#imm. Unique imm8. Raising hides a shorted/disconnected sensor; lowering trips more easily on noise.

torque_sensor_fault_adc_high.label: Torque sensor fault ADC high
torque_sensor_fault_adc_high.summary: Upper torque-ADC fault limit during the 16-tick post-learn window (stock 2867 = 3000−133).
torque_sensor_fault_adc_high.notes: LearnTorqueOffsetAndFaults: ldr lit 3000 then subs r1,#imm; fault if adc > 3000−imm in the count+offset < 16 window. Pool word 0x100080D0 is also the 3000-tick re-zero timer — only patch this subtract. Effective high = 3000−imm.

torque_assist_rise_shift.label: Torque assist rise shift
torque_assist_rise_shift.summary: Per-tick rise toward torque-assist target uses delta>>N when delta > 2^N−1 (stock N=3). Larger N = slower build-up.
torque_assist_rise_shift.notes: CalculateTorqueAssistCurrent: cmp #2^N−1 then lsrs #N into the rise step (else +1). Patches both the compare and the lsrs imm5.

torque_assist_fall_shift.label: Torque assist fall shift
torque_assist_fall_shift.summary: Decay step toward the torque-assist target uses delta>>N when delta > 2^N−1 (stock N=2). Larger N = longer assist tail.
torque_assist_fall_shift.notes: CalculateTorqueAssistCurrent fall path: cmp #2^N−1 then lsrs #N. Independent of the rise shift.

torque_adc_slew_shift.label: Torque ADC slew shift
torque_adc_slew_shift.summary: How aggressively the ride loop slews the 4-sample torque ADC average into 0x20002710 (stock N=5 → step delta>>5 when |delta|>31).
torque_adc_slew_shift.notes: RunRideControlLoop: two mirror arms each cmp #2^N−1 then asrs #N. All four sites stay in sync. Smaller N tracks pedal torque faster (more noise).

assist_ramp_up_shift.label: Assist ramp-up shift
assist_ramp_up_shift.summary: How fast wCurrentTarget rises toward the full-current assist limit when cadence/torque flags are set (stock N=4 → step delta>>4 when delta>15).
assist_ramp_up_shift.notes: RunRideControlLoop assist branch (cadence bit11 + torque flag bit3): cmp #2^N−1 then asrs #N into wCurrentTarget, then min with g_wAssistCurrentTarget. Runs every 4th ride pass. Larger N = softer onset.

assist_ramp_down_shift.label: Assist ramp-down shift
assist_ramp_down_shift.summary: How fast wCurrentTarget falls when the alt full-current limit drops below the live target (stock N=4). Pedal release uses a separate halve-per-pass path.
assist_ramp_down_shift.notes: RunRideControlLoop assist branch down arm: cmp #2^N−1 then asrs #N. Rarely taken because alt is normally the constant full-current limit; visible mainly when thermal/ride clamps lower that limit.

torque_slope_engage_delta.label: Torque-slope engage delta
torque_slope_engage_delta.summary: Minimum torque-ADC rise in one sample window that can wake assist below the static deadband (stock 30).
torque_slope_engage_delta.notes: CalculateTorqueAssistCurrent: assist engages when adc > offset+deadband OR (cadence bit11 and (torque flag already set OR 0x200025A8 > this)). 0x200025A8 is written by DecodePasCadencePulseEdges once per torque_adc_rise_window. Lower values engage on smaller pedal pushes (more twitch).

wheel_period_constant_k.label: Wheel-period fade constant K
wheel_period_constant_k.summary: Rebuilds fade-hi period as wheel_code×K/speed (stock K=573 = 819−246). Acts as a speed-calibration scale for when fade starts.
wheel_period_constant_k.notes: RebuildWheelSpeedFadeThresholds: ldr lit 819 from 0x10008994 then subs #imm. Pool word is also the throttle-lockout trip compare at 0x10008780 — only patch this subtract. Effective K = 819−imm.

hall_fault_debounce.label: Hall fault debounce
hall_fault_debounce.summary: Invalid hall codes 0/7 may accumulate above this before fault code 10 latches (stock 3). Counter resets only on the PWM-idle path.
hall_fault_debounce.notes: RunRideControlLoop: byte at 0x200025BF; cmp #imm then set flags+4 bit23. Raising hides hall wiring faults; not a consecutive-only debounce.

fault_report_debounce.label: Fault-code report debounce
fault_report_debounce.summary: Display fault codes stay suppressed for this many consecutive UpdateMotorFaultCode polls (stock 30). Direct protect-bit motor cuts are unaffected.
fault_report_debounce.notes: UpdateMotorFaultCode: while code!=0 and counter 0x200025CA < this, force the reported code to 0 and increment. RunRideControlLoop / EnableMotorPwmWhenReady gate on the reported byte at 0x20002B05. 0 reports every fault instantly; large values delay display-error motor cuts.

hall_advance_mid_threshold.label: Hall advance mid threshold
hall_advance_mid_threshold.summary: Hall-rate band edge for the medium advance (stock 2000 = 125<<4). Also supplies the coupled low-band +2000 advance amount.
hall_advance_mid_threshold.notes: ProcessHallAngleAdvance: movs #imm; lsls #4. Rate bands: >high_thr → +high, >this → +medium, >low_thr → +this same register value, else 0. Changing this moves both the mid boundary and the low-band advance magnitude.

hall_advance_low_threshold.label: Hall advance low threshold
hall_advance_low_threshold.summary: Lower edge of the low hall-advance band (stock 1000 = 125<<3). No amount coupling on this immediate.
hall_advance_low_threshold.notes: ProcessHallAngleAdvance: movs #imm; lsls #3. Unique from the mid-threshold encoding. Keep below hall_advance_mid_threshold.

foc_throttle_gate_base.label: FOC throttle gate base
foc_throttle_gate_base.summary: FOC ISR throttle-in-window low edge (stock 1240). When ADC is in-window and PAS≠0 the ISR skips the torque-demand cap. Separate from Throttle ADC low edge.
foc_throttle_gate_base.notes: ProcessFocCurrentControlIsr: movs #imm; lsls #3 → stock 0x9B<<3=1240 (=0x4D8). Span literal 0x939 is shared with a 2300-tick hold timer and is not exposed. Align with throttle_adc_low (~1241) when retuning the handlebar window.
